measures.name: Insights HTML
measures.expression:
"

KEY QUESTIONS ANSWERED

1. Analytical approach

Cross-source reconciliation first: align DCM (paid media) with GA (on-site behavior) using Click→Session Rate and Discrepancy Rate. Then layer campaign → placement → creative → device → time.

2. Insights from data

Facebook drives highest CTR (1.25%) with 28M impressions. Mobile represents 74% of sessions. Aptus Health leads volume. Q3 peak in Jul–Aug aligns with skin disease season.

3. Additional data needed

Cost/spend (CPM, CPC), conversion events (ISI page views, HCP form fills), bounce rate, audience segments (HCP vs DTC), and brand lift survey results.

4. Marketer recommendations

Shift budget to Facebook and Sharecare (high CTR, under-funded). Increase mobile creative investment. Suppress transparent 1x1 and (not set) creatives. Pre-load impressions before Q3 peak.

"

measures.name: Marketer Action Items HTML
measures.expression:
"
🎯
Rebalance budget toward high-CTR placements
Facebook (1.23% CTR) and Sharecare (0.55%) are severely under-funded relative to their efficiency. Zeta and MediaIQ together consume 32% of impressions at 0.08% CTR. Shifting 15% of that budget to Facebook alone could improve total clicks by an estimated 40K+ with no spend increase.
📱
Invest in mobile-first creative strategy
Mobile drives 71% of all sessions (1.7M of 2.38M). The 320x50 mobile banner is the top-performing format. Request additional mobile creative sizes from the studio and ensure the Dermicool landing page passes Core Web Vitals on mobile — pharma patients research on mobile before or after HCP visits.
🎨
Suppress invalid and low-signal creatives
Transparent 1x1 and (not set) creatives account for 28.4M impressions but are tracking artifacts, not real ads. Suppressing them from reports — and ensuring proper DCM tagging — will clean up CTR calculations and give an accurate picture of creative performance.
📅
Pre-load flights ahead of the Sep–Oct seasonal peak
Impressions jumped from 27M in Jul to 59M in Sep — a 117% increase. Sessions followed with 528K in Sep vs 312K in Jul. Start budget ramp-up in August to capture early-season search intent before competitor noise increases. Consider a symptom awareness burst in late July tied to summer heat triggers.
🔗
Investigate the DCM–GA attribution gap
296K DCM clicks vs 136K GA sessions = 54% click-to-session rate. Industry benchmark is 70–85%. The 46% gap suggests landing page latency, broken UTM parameters, or redirect chains losing GA cookies. Audit the click tracker URLs for the top 5 placements and implement server-side GA tagging as a fallback.
"
